en.why_it_matters: The exact package is the reason to make room. Igorrr's current collision of extreme metal, electronics and baroque/classical color meets Trey Spruance's Secret Chiefs 3, while Japan's Violent Magic Orchestra pushes the night toward industrial, electronic and black-metal extremity. There is even a current musical bridge: Spruance guests on 'Blastbeat Falafel' from Amen. This is a deliberately unstable heavy-music border crossing, not a routine metal stop.
en.trip_verdict: From the DMV, this is a plausible dedicated Baltimore run up I-95. If this exact heavy/avant-garde package is the draw, build the evening around Soundstage rather than treating it as an add-on to a larger corridor trip.
